subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Threshold Guardians
description: A quick win: understand Threshold Guardians.

hook.text: Cerberus guards the gates of Hades. The Sphinx blocks the road to Thebes. Gatekeepers test the worthy.

buildup.text: Before entering the new world, the hero faces a guardian—someone or something that tests readiness.

discovery.text: The test isn't always combat. The Sphinx gave a riddle. Guardians test wisdom as often as strength.

twist.text: Sometimes the guardian is internal. Fear, arrogance, or attachment to the past blocks the way.

climax.text: Defeating the guardian proves transformation has begun. The hero is no longer who they were.

punchline.text: The gate opens only for the changed.

quiz.question: What role do threshold guardians serve in myth?
options: They test whether the hero is ready
